name: Needle Rain
body:
School transmutation [metal]; Level magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, M (a metal needle)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target up to 5 targets

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

Metal: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate metal in some manner or conjure creatures composed of metal. Such spells are considered to belong to the Metal element (for geomancers) and the metal elemental school (for metal elementalists).

You toss up the needle and it splits into a multitude of needles that rain down on targets. You make a ranged touch attack against up to 5 targets in range, with separate rolls for each target. The spell deals a total of 1d4 magic piercing per caster level, to a maximum of 5d4. The damage is split between each of the targets in 1d4 intervals. So you cannot target more creatures than you have d4s of damage.
